shared_or_similar_visual_information: A hollow circular marker on a plotted graph
mathematical_meanings: Left image: A hole: this marked position on the curve is excluded; the separate filled point supplies the function value at the same horizontal coordinate. Right image: An excluded endpoint of the displayed function graph.
Rationales: The first is an interior hole and the second an endpoint, but both hollow circles specifically exclude the marked position. No claim is made about excluding the entire corresponding y-value from the range.
